patterns.skill_gap: First M6 mutation was a no-op (injected key next to a widget-only key absent from presets) — verify injection landed (grep) before running the suite.
patterns.what_was_hard: Shadow-copy baseline needed the full file set the suite reads (main.lua, classes/, hud.lua) — chased missing-file asserts one by one before switching to a full cp -r copy.
patterns.what_worked: Consumer-first gating: only RipCP had a live db reader, so only one widget shipped; everything else filed with key shape + missing consumer. Filed pins proved live via M5-M7 kills.
